name: What are the differences between framed and frameless shower glass?

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between framed and frameless shower glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framed shower enclosures feature metal around the edges of the glass panels, offering robust support and often a lower cost. Frameless enclosures use thicker glass and minimal hardware, creating an open, modern aesthetic that is easier to clean. The choice between them often involves a tradeoff: framed offers more design flexibility for uneven openings but a more traditional look, while frameless provides a sleek appearance with less visual interruption, but requires precise measurements for a tight fit and a flat, level shower curb.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framed enclosures have metal frames, offering support and lower cost. Frameless use thicker glass and minimal hardware for a modern look, but require precise installation.
